_comment: Canonical daily voice-test set for Aria. Read questions aloud, then run: venv/bin/python daily_check.py report. 'match' keywords are checked against flight-log transcripts (all must appear, case-insensitive) — keep them short and transcription-tolerant. 'core' questions are the ~3-minute daily set; the rest are the weekly sweep. After editing, regenerate the markdown sheet: venv/bin/python daily_check.py list --md > tests/daily_questions.md

questions.expect: Says F. Scott Fitzgerald in one sentence, no tools needed.
Says Canberra.
Uses web search, speaks current conditions for Buffalo.

questions.q: Search the web for the latest Python version
questions.expect: Speaks the current release number, not a stale one from memory.

questions.q: (right after the weather answer, into the open mic) What about tomorrow?
questions.expect: Mic pop plays after the previous answer; follow-up is understood WITHOUT hotkey or wake word and answers for tomorrow.
Aria says 'Anytime.' and the conversation window closes.
Notes opens WITHOUT stealing focus from the current app; Aria confirms.
GitHub opens in the default browser; Aria says 'Opening GitHub'.
Screen brightness visibly increases; Aria confirms.
Music starts (Apple Music/Spotify/YouTube per router); Aria names what it's playing.
Playback pauses. Single-word command must be accepted.
Names the current track, or says nothing is playing.

questions.q: What's on my screen right now?
questions.expect: Describes the actual visible window contents — never guesses. Needs Screen Recording permission.

questions.q: Show me where the Apple menu is
questions.expect: Draws a box near the top-left Apple menu and says where it is. Known weak link: ~80% coordinate accuracy.
Summarizes recent iMessages, does not dump raw data.

questions.q: Text mom saying I'll call tonight — then answer NO at the confirmation
questions.expect: Aria states the message and asks to confirm BEFORE sending; saying no must abort with nothing sent.

questions.q: Remember that my favorite coffee is cold brew
questions.expect: Acknowledges saving it.
Says cold brew — recalled from vector memory, works even next session.
Summarizes recent inbox (needs Gmail setup); graceful message if not configured.
Reads today's events or says the day is clear.

questions.q: Remind me to stretch in two hours
questions.expect: Confirms the reminder; it should actually fire later via cron.

questions.q: Search for machine learning engineer jobs
questions.expect: Speaks top results with company names; 'tell me more about the second job' should then work.
Weather + calendar + email + news in one spoken summary.

questions.q: Compare the price of AirPods Pro on Amazon and Best Buy
questions.expect: Runs the background browser loop, speaks progress, returns both prices. Browser must not steal focus.

questions.q: Write a Python script that prints the first ten prime numbers and run it
questions.expect: Writes, runs, and speaks the result.

questions.q: How have you been performing this week?
questions.expect: Reads the flight-recorder stats: command count, failure count, worst tool.
Says 'I didn't catch that' — never crashes. (Not log-matched; verify by ear.)
Asks for clarification or admits it can't — never pretends it did something.
